mentions.name: Watermark'd
mentions.description: Watermark'd gives businesses a verified digital identity that works across the globe, starting with businesses registered in South Asia — described as a DUNS number for the 21st century. It verifies that a business is registered in its claimed jurisdiction, verifies whether individuals have the authority to act on behalf of that business, and provides shareable credentials.
mentions.problem: Businesses lack a modern, globally recognized digital identity; existing identifiers like DUNS are outdated for the 21st century.
mentions.audience: Businesses, starting with businesses registered in South Asia
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm working on Watermark'd. We want to give businesses a verified digital identity that works across the globe starting with businesses registered in South Asia (DUNS number that works for the 21st century).
